expected_response.note: Incumbent retained; no permitted bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage on the supplied evidence.

failure_modes: Treating diagnostic pair-kernel, moment or joint-motion contrasts as terms of the executing pointcloud reward, which contains none of them.
Reading a sign on one observable (softmin vs occupancy) as a shared quality axis and selecting a region_index edit on that basis.
Using observed-node linear fits as a temporal teacher despite polynomial_accepted false and legendre_runtime_allowed false for all selected curves.
Interpreting joint-motion residual diagnostics as rigid-motion residuals of region moments or as atom velocities.
Presenting recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity benefit when decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false.
Proposing a temperature edit, which is an interface violation rather than a research condition.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible endpoint contrasts (short-range pair_kernel_1.5-3.5 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 reversed; shape_yy negative; joint internal/innovation RMS negative) are diagnostic observables, and the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so no registered bounded edit maps those contrasts onto the operative reward. The only operative coordinate knob is pointcloud_delta_A, which sets the robust curvature of the Hungarian endpoint-distance penalty; the evidence does not identify a defensible expected advantage for changing it from the incumbent 1.0 A, and the information audit explicitly states its comparison is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian. Region_index and temporal_region_index edits would only reweight detached landmark attention without a supported favorable direction, since softmin/occupancy signs are mixed across regions and no selected curve has legendre_runtime_allowed true (relative node RMSE 0.386-0.931, up to 15 strong sign-conflict nodes), so the observed-node linear fits are not usable as a temporal teacher. Teacher_neighbors is a count, not a distance bandwidth, and the supplied teacher provenance and fixed temperatures are preserved; no evidence supports narrowing or broadening the neighborhood. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Because the affinity-first objective is primary and the evidence provides no defensible expected advantage for any permitted edit, retaining the incumbent is the correct bounded choice; deferral is unnecessary since the incumbent is a valid fallback and no edit is warranted.
